title: Zesty Tunisian King Prawns Ceviche
description: A jammy, molten, cozy Tunisian ceviche featuring raw king prawns with bright citrus, harissa, and fresh herbs. Keto-friendly and bursting with savory spice.
instructions: Clean and devein the king prawns, then cut them into bite-size pieces.
Place the prawns in a bowl and pour the lime and lemon juices over them, ensuring they are fully covered.
Add the harissa paste and olive oil, stirring to combine the flavors evenly.
Fold in the chopped cilantro, mint, and diced red onion, then season with salt and pepper.
Let the mixture marinate in the refrigerator for 10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the ceviche cold in chilled glasses or small bowls for an elegant presentation.
Garnish with an extra sprinkle of herbs and a wedge of lime if desired.
Enjoy the zesty, keto-friendly Tunisian king prawns ceviche as a vibrant dinner starter or light meal.
